verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence pack shows WezTerm ships one. The documented CLI, headless mux control loop and Lua event hooks are building blocks that external agents could drive, not a built-in assistant that accepts delegated tasks, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
